# MonoGray

MonoGray is a light theme built on a monochrome grayscale palette, recorded with a #f9f9f9 background, #1a1a1a text and subtle gray accents for interactive elements. Its README states full coverage of the Obsidian interface and typography tuned for both Chinese and English, and the repository is released under the MIT license.

![MonoGray screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmj-eo/obsidian-monogray/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "MonoGray"
    author: "太乙"
    repo:   "jmj-eo/obsidian-monogray"
    slug:   "monogray"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/monogray"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/jmj-eo/obsidian-monogray"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmj-eo/obsidian-monogray/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["light"]
}
```
